# HappyHands

> HappyHands is an open-source local design review tool for products built with coding agents. Use the lightweight Skill or optional workbench. It helps connect screenshots, project design rules, scoped code changes and review decisions. Current status: v1.0.0.

## Official sources

- [English product website](https://happyhands.cc/en/apps/portal/): Product scope, design resources and local setup entry.
- [中文官网](https://happyhands.cc/apps/portal/): 产品范围、设计资源与本地安装入口。
- [English guide](https://happyhands.cc/en/guide/): Local setup, supported tool roles, design resources, review workflow, data handling and limitations.
- [中文使用指南](https://happyhands.cc/guide/): 本地安装、编码工具接入、设计资源、审阅流程、数据与限制。
- [Core source](https://github.com/ShuaiMXu/happyhands): Original HappyHands core code is MIT licensed. Third-party dependencies retain their own terms.
- [Lightweight v1.0.0 guide](https://github.com/ShuaiMXu/happyhands/blob/main/docs/lightweight.md): Skill installation, reference selection, default run storage and execution limits.
- [v1.0.0 release](https://github.com/ShuaiMXu/happyhands/releases/tag/v1.0.0): Release asset and actual validation scope.
- [Harness documentation](https://github.com/ShuaiMXu/happyhands/blob/main/docs/harness.md): Commands and execution boundaries.
- [Website source](https://github.com/ShuaiMXu/happyhands-site): Public website implementation.

## Design and review workflows

- [AI UI review](https://happyhands.cc/en/ai-ui-review/): Screenshot evidence, project rules, scoped repair and human acceptance; not general code review.
- [AI 界面评审](https://happyhands.cc/ai-ui-review/): 可复现问题、截图证据与前后复核。
- [AI website design workflow](https://happyhands.cc/en/ai-website-design/): Improve an existing AI-generated interface; not a hosted website builder.
- [AI 网站设计](https://happyhands.cc/ai-website-design/): 从初稿、设计方向到可复核的界面优化。

- [Nonprofit website design review](https://happyhands.cc/en/nonprofit-website-design/): Donation and volunteer task checks, mobile UX and human review. A practical guide, not a client case study.
- [公益网站设计评审](https://happyhands.cc/nonprofit-website-design/): 捐赠与志愿报名任务、移动端体验及评审边界。

## Product facts

- The website provides guidance and design resources. Review execution uses the Harness through the lightweight Skill, source CLI or optional local workbench.
- Start with the v1.0.0 lightweight Skill using Node.js 22.15+, npm, Git, Chrome or Edge and a configured agent. Follow the linked guide for the pinned release install command. The default destination is the Codex user Skill directory, leaving product source untouched and refusing to overwrite an existing Skill.
- The source CLI and visual workbench remain optional. With pnpm 11.19.0, clone the core repository, run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `pnpm workbench`.
- Codex CLI supports model diagnosis, screenshot-aware review and implementation. Claude Code has an implementation adapter; complete end-to-end validation remains open.
- Cursor, Kimi Code, WorkBuddy and DSH can operate the Harness with local browser, terminal and repository access. They do not have dedicated implementation adapters in this version.
- The lightweight Skill uses the existing Harness and pinned methods. It can snapshot selected design references, but selection does not install components or approve a design system. Installation alone is not a verified repair, and Claude Code Skill discovery does not establish a tested end-to-end execution loop.
- Review coverage follows the confirmed capture plan. A person accepts or rejects changes; a passing model review does not establish whole-product acceptance.
- Lightweight runs default to `~/.happyhands/runs`; the source CLI and workbench default to `.harness/`. An explicit output path can override these locations. Model-assisted steps send selected source context and screenshots through the configured CLI to the model provider. Processing is not entirely local.
- Original core source is MIT licensed. Third-party code, fonts, assets and dependencies retain their own licenses; tldraw has separate production-use requirements. Model providers may charge separately.

## Design resources

- [Resource library](https://happyhands.cc/components/): Design systems, attributed component previews and design references.
- [HappyHands design system](https://happyhands.cc/systems/happyhands/): Semantic tokens and product UI examples.
- [Quartz reference](https://happyhands.cc/systems/quartz/): AI workflows and professional tools; upstream source is design.how.
- [Lime reference](https://happyhands.cc/systems/lime/): Personal assistants and consumer apps; upstream source is design.how.

This file is a factual reading aid, not an indexing requirement or a guarantee of search ranking or AI citations. The linked user-facing guides contain the same scope and limitations.
